name: bonsai
tagline: A library for building dynamic webapps with Js_of_ocaml
description: bonsai is Jane Street's OCaml library for building dynamic web applications, compiling to JavaScript via Js_of_ocaml. It brings Jane Street's functional programming discipline to the frontend: incremental computation, a principled component model, and state management that scales to large internal applications. Recently trending on GitHub, it is the strongest argument that OCaml's ecosystem is ready for serious web work.
highlights: Jane Street's production-grade functional web framework for OCaml
Built on Js_of_ocaml and Incremental for principled state and updates
Battle-tested inside Jane Street on large internal applications
Trending again as OCaml web development gets renewed attention
curatorNote: Jane Street rarely open-sources its frontend stack, and bonsai shows why the rest of us should care: incremental computation removes an entire class of state bugs. The OCaml-to-web story is niche but the engineering is world-class.
